sites.label: Industrial Tower & Wireless monopole — Hadley St (Rte 47), South Hadley
sites.source: FCC ASR 1309677 (FCC ASR DB via Safari) + Planning Board
sites.note: The main cell site serving western South Hadley — a ~150 ft monopole now hosting FOUR operators: T-Mobile, Sprint(→T-Mobile), Verizon, and Dish (see the offset carrier pins). Built in 2018 by tower company Industrial Tower & Wireless to replace the demolished Mt. Tom power-station smokestack in Holyoke. Engineered for up to 5 carriers; FCC ASR 1309677.

sites.label: Verizon — rooftop, Clapp Lab (Mount Holyoke College), South Hadley
sites.source: South Hadley Planning Board special permit, 2015 (approx. — building centroid)
sites.note: Verizon Wireless rooftop antennas (6 antennas + 9 RRHs) around the Clapp Laboratory turret at Mount Holyoke College, approved by the South Hadley Planning Board in 2015. Sub-200 ft, so NOT in the FCC ASR. Coordinate is the building centroid (approximate, not surveyed to the antenna).

sites.label: T-Mobile (metroPCS) — South Hadley High School chimney, 153 Newton St
sites.note: SIX panel antennas on the South Hadley High School smokestack + three BTS cabinets at its base, leased from the School Dept. The ONLY carrier permit on the smokestack is metroPCS (→ T-Mobile). NOTE: it is NOT Verizon — every town/FCC record shows metroPCS/T-Mobile here (with AT&T as a tenant); the nearby Verizon site is Mount Holyoke's Clapp Lab, ~1 mile away. 153 Newton St, Map 17 Parcel 015.

sites.label: T-Mobile / Sprint — 14 Mulligan Dr water tank, South Hadley
sites.note: T-Mobile / Sprint antennas on the 14 Mulligan Dr water tank (the Alvord St tank, South Hadley Fire District #1). FCC-surveyed point (ULS WQPU414/WQPU560). This tank is a 3-carrier macro — likely the 'more sites' you knew were there.

sites.label: Verizon 5G — 14 Mulligan Dr water tank, South Hadley
sites.note: Verizon 5G on the 14 Mulligan Dr water tank — SH building permit B-22-329 (2022): removed 15 / installed 12 antennas, 5G upgrade. Co-located with T-Mobile and AT&T on the same tank (pins offset a few metres so all three are tappable).

sites.label: AT&T — 14 Mulligan Dr water tank, South Hadley
sites.note: AT&T on the 14 Mulligan Dr water tank — SH building permit B-19-257 (2019): antenna/RRU swap as a tenant on the existing facility. Co-located with T-Mobile and Verizon on the same tank.

sites.label: AT&T — 8 Industrial Dr water tank, South Hadley
sites.source: FCC ULS (surveyed) + SH permits B-17-120/261, B-18-295, B-20-367
sites.note: AT&T (Cingular) macro on the 8 Industrial Drive water tank in southern South Hadley — FCC ULS WPXE394/WPXE396, surveyed coordinate.

sites.label: Mount Holyoke College — additional carrier rooftop (campus)
sites.source: SH Planning Board 2015 decision (other carriers already on campus)
sites.note: Mount Holyoke College hosts MORE than Verizon: the 2015 Verizon/Clapp-Lab decision notes other carrier(s) were already on a campus building, and the college holds 4 FCC license records. The specific carrier/building isn't named in the record. Coordinate = campus center (50 College St).

sites.label: 15 Skinner Lane water tank — Fire Dist #2 (candidate host)
sites.note: Skinner Lane elevated water tank (15 Skinner Ln) — now FCC-confirmed (ULS WQGQ208, South Hadley Fire District #2). Water tanks here host carriers (cf. Mulligan & Industrial Dr); the specific carrier tenants aren't confirmed yet — a strong stealth host.

sites.label: Fire District #1 HQ, 144 Newton St — FCC site (candidate host)
sites.note: South Hadley Fire District #1 headquarters, 144 Newton St — FCC-registered antenna site (district radio), next to the high school. Possible carrier host; carrier(s) unconfirmed.

sites.label: Big Y plaza rooftop, 44 Willimansett St (candidate)
sites.note: CANDIDATE (unconfirmed). Big Y plaza, 44 Willimansett St — large supermarket rooftops are common carrier collocation sites. No lease confirmed in the records reviewed; included as a lead to verify.

sites.label: Loomis Village rooftop, 246 N Main St (candidate)
sites.note: CANDIDATE (unconfirmed). Loomis Village senior-living campus, 246 N Main St — multi-story buildings are typical rooftop-lease hosts. No lease confirmed; lead to verify.

sites.label: Verizon — 8 Industrial Dr water tank, South Hadley
sites.note: Verizon on the 8 Industrial Dr water tank — SH building permit B-18-458 (2018). This tank hosts three carriers (AT&T, Verizon, T-Mobile). Pin offset a few metres from the others.

sites.label: T-Mobile — 8 Industrial Dr water tank, South Hadley
sites.note: T-Mobile on the 8 Industrial Dr water tank — SH permits E-19-33 (generator) & B-21-702 (facility modification). Co-located with AT&T and Verizon on the same tank.

sites.label: Dish Wireless — ITW Hadley St monopole, South Hadley
sites.note: Dish Wireless on the Industrial Tower & Wireless monopole (Hadley St) — SH building permit B-21-555 (2021): 3 antennas + 6 RRUs at the 120 ft level. The ITW monopole now hosts FOUR operators: T-Mobile, Sprint(→T-Mobile), Verizon, and Dish. Pin offset a few metres from the tower.

sites.label: Verizon — ITW Hadley St monopole, South Hadley
sites.note: Verizon on the Industrial Tower & Wireless monopole (Hadley St) — FAA filing 2022-ANE-4637-OE at the tower's exact coordinates. Co-located with T-Mobile/Sprint and Dish. Pin offset slightly.

sites.label: T-Mobile monopole — 274 Amherst Rd, South Hadley
sites.source: SH building permits B-22-33 / B-22-379 (2022); OpenGov surveyed coord
sites.note: A T-Mobile macro on its own compound at 274 Amherst Rd — SH building permits B-22-33 and B-22-379 (2022): antenna/RRU swaps on an existing equipment platform. A distinct site, not on the ITW monopole.

sites.label: Verizon — rooftop/facade, Mount Holyoke College (College St)
sites.note: A SECOND Verizon installation on the Mount Holyoke campus — a rooftop/facade install (SH permit B-22-205, 2022), separate from Verizon's Clapp Lab turret site at 27 Park St. Campus parcel (College St).

sites.label: T-Mobile — Williston Library steeple, Mount Holyoke College
sites.note: T-Mobile concealed its antennas IN the steeple of the Williston Memorial Library at Mount Holyoke College — SH building permit B-22-598 (2022). A classic stealth steeple install.

sites.label: T-Mobile — 9 Camp Perkins Rd (Girl Scout camp), South Hadley
sites.source: SH permit E-17-160 (T-Mobile generator); OpenGov surveyed coord
sites.note: A multi-carrier cell on the Girl Scouts' Camp Lewis Perkins land (9 Camp Perkins Rd). T-Mobile: permit E-17-160 (2017), an 80 kW generator 'for T-Mobile'. Co-located with Verizon (see the Verizon pin). OpenGov surveyed coordinate.

sites.label: Verizon — 9 Camp Perkins Rd (Girl Scout camp), South Hadley
sites.note: Verizon at 9 Camp Perkins Rd — the OpenGov permit portal shows a Verizon Wireless antenna permit (2014) here, co-located with T-Mobile on the Girl Scout camp land. Pin offset slightly from T-Mobile.

sites.label: Fire District #2 HQ, 20 Woodbridge St — FCC site (candidate host)
sites.note: CANDIDATE host. South Hadley Fire District #2 headquarters, 20 Woodbridge St — an FCC-registered antenna site (the district's own radio). Carrier colocation possible but unconfirmed.

sites.label: Fire District #1 site, 438 Granby Rd — FCC site (candidate host)
sites.note: CANDIDATE host. South Hadley Fire District #1 site at 438 Granby Rd — FCC-registered (district radio). Carrier colocation possible but unconfirmed.
